title: Chapter 4 Quiz 6
description: Shifting values to close the gap.
instructions: Take your time: read each question carefully, then check your answer.

questions.question: Put the steps to delete an element in order.
items: Reduce the size of the array by 1
Ask for the position to delete
Shift the following elements one place to the left

questions.question: How is an element removed from the middle of an array?
options: The cell is skipped for ever
The cell is cleared with a zero
questions.explanation: Shifting closes the gap; then the size is reduced. Watch out: leaving a zero would keep a hole in the data.

questions.question: Complete the deletion of position pos in an array of N elements.
questions.code:
For i From pos To {{1}} Do
    array[i] ← array[{{2}}]
EndFor
N ← N - 1
questions.explanation: We copy each element from its right neighbour, up to N - 1. Then N shrinks by 1.

questions.question: The array is [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]. We delete position 2. Give the array after each shift.
questions.explanation: Each shift moves a value left. The last 50 is left over and ignored once N becomes 4. Watch out: the last cell still holds 50, but it is no longer part of the array.

questions.question: After the deletion, what is the new size N? (N was 5)
After deleting position 2 of [10, 20, 30, 40, 50], which value is now in position 2?
questions.explanation: 30 moved from position 3 to position 2. Watch out: position 2 held 20 before, and 20 is the value that was deleted.

questions.question: When deleting, the loop must run over all N cells including the last one.
questions.explanation: The last shift copies array[N] into array[N-1], so the loop stops at N - 1. Watch out: going to N would read array[N + 1], outside the array.

questions.question: This should delete the element at position pos from an array of N elements. One line is wrong. Find it and choose the fix.
questions.code:
For i From pos To N Do
    array[i] ← array[i + 1]
EndFor
N ← N - 1
options: For i From pos + 1 To N Do
For i From 1 To N - 1 Do
For i From pos To N - 1 Do
For i From pos To N + 1 Do
questions.explanation: On the last pass i = N - 1 copies array[N]. Watch out: with To N, array[N + 1] is read, and it does not exist.

questions.question: This should delete the element at position pos. One line has an error.
questions.code:
For i From pos To N - 1 Do
    array[i + 1] ← array[i]
EndFor
N ← N - 1
questions.explanation: We must copy from the right neighbour into the cell: array[i] ← array[i + 1]. Watch out: the reversed copy spreads the value to the right and deletes nothing.
